predictor.notes: Used 24 business requests and 8 REA operations, including inspection. All 21 successful responses disclosed totals rounded to 100000 cents; approved requests at quantities 100, 500 and 1000 were denied. Assuming monotone prices and nearest-increment rounding, observations bracket the 50000-cent crossing between quantities 28 and 31, the 150000-cent crossing between 231 and 241, and the 250000-cent crossing between 703 and 711. This predictor linearly interpolates the midpoint crossing estimates, assumes a zero-price origin, and extrapolates the final slope to quantity 1000. It is consistent with every observed rounded total. Its segment starts are interpolation choices, not discovered pricing-band boundaries. Exact prices, curvature, fixed fees and additional bands remain unidentifiable from these observations; this is an approximate predictor, not a verified exact reconstruction.
